capture.zh: 在晶蛇魔窟挑战洛拉斯克，打败获得精元。

strategy_notes.zh: 未找到同期攻略；地面系，草、水、冰、飞行（免疫地面技能）系有利。

engine_notes: No 2012 source for this fight was found. Rules (immune_pct_damage, immune_status, innate atk+2, 10000 HP) are a placeholder modelled on the neighbouring SPT bosses (库里 2012-11, 伊索里 2012-12) and must be verified.
skills: sources name no (or only some) boss skills; the team uses the species' four top learnset skills (Lv49-61). Every 2011-2012 SPT boss whose skills a source does list used exactly these four.
reward: original reward was the species' 精元 (essence), hatched in the 分子转化器 into the base form (e.g. 兰斯特 精元 → 卡斯, 伊索里 → 伊索的精元); encoded as the base-form species at Lv1.
source_note: Only species data and the game's SPT list (habitat 晶蛇魔窟) were available; era inferred from species id between 库里 and 伊索里.
